messages:
maria.dev: Heads up — after the firmware push to edge-rack-23 the fancurve changed and cooling thresholds spiked. GPUs hit thermal throttle and provisioning failures started around 03:12 UTC. Reverting canary? @infra-bot

jakeops: Seen it. Telemetry shows fan PWM stuck at ~30% despite GPU temps at 80–88°C on edge-23-01..04. Node 03 already reported a provisioning timeout.

sasha-sre: Can we cordon/drain the rack before more jobs get killed? Marking as degraded in the dashboard.

anita: I opened INT-4823 for the rollback run. Rollback window scheduled 03:30 UTC. Quick Q: does this firmware touch secure boot/UEFI options?

maria.dev: It's a micro-update (micro-v2) that accidentally toggled a UEFI thermal mitigation policy. It shouldn't flip SecureBoot flags, but the BMC cold-reset path during flash can flip bootpolicy on some OEM images. Need to be careful.

infra-bot: [deploybot] 1745009876 - firmware-update micro-v2 applied to edge-rack-23 nodes: edge-23-01, edge-23-02, edge-23-03, edge-23-04

lee: IPMI logs show repeated MC resets during the flash: `ipmitool mc reset cold` spammed. BMC watchdog kicking. Could cause partial reboots and provisioning timeouts.

jakeops: Snippet of kernel/IPMI log: ```Apr 12 03:12:45 kernel: bmc_watchdog: reset initiated
ipmi_si: session close: 12:34
Apr 12 03:12:46 provisioning: node edge-23-02: gpu init timeout
```

maria.dev: Rolling fallback to micro-v1 on affected nodes now. Start with 01 and 02 to validate rollback behavior.

sasha-sre: Plan: 1) cordon nodes 01/02 2) drain GPU pods (checkpoint long jobs) 3) flash micro-v1 4) validate fan PWM & temps 5) uncordon 6) monitor for IPMI reset rate 

anita: Note on cost/impact: queued training jobs in eu-west-1 will be delayed ~2 hours. Ops burn this month already high — flagging to finance.

jakeops: Executing: `fleetctl flash --image micro-v1 --hosts edge-23-01,edge-23-02 --force`

infra-bot: [fleet] flash job queued id=fj-98321 for hosts edge-23-01,edge-23-02

maria.dev: After flashing edge-23-01, PWM returned to expected ~70% idle at 55°C under same load. No GPU throttles observed. Holding on 23-02 for a second observation window.

lee: Watchpoint: confirm no BootOrder or efivar changes after the cold reset. Check `/sys/firmware/efi/efivars/BootOrder-*` and `dmesg` for BootGuard messages.

sasha-sre: Verified on 23-01: no BootGuard/secureboot change. BMC logs show `UEFI ThermalPolicy=1` on micro-v2, micro-v1 reports `UEFI ThermalPolicy=0`. That correlates with the observed downscaling.

anita: Please add a short postmortem blurb and update the rollout runbook to gate canaries on fan PWM delta (>15%) and IPMI reset rate (>3 resets/min).

maria.dev: Will write the blurb. TL;DR: micro-v2 inadvertently enabled an aggressive thermal mitigation flag which reduced fan duty and caused GPU thermal throttle and provisioning failures. Rollback to micro-v1 on affected nodes restored normal PWM and resolved provisioning issues. Next steps: tighten canary checks, rate-limit IPMI resets during flash, add explicit check for efivars BootOrder invariance in the flash agent.

jakeops: Also recommend future firmware windows be restricted to low-traffic maintenance windows; plus add a temporary budget alert for ops spend if rollbacks cause >1.5x expected runtime.

sasha-sre: +1. Add a kernel oops alert for IPMI session storms and a dashboard panel for fan PWM delta per rack.

maria.dev: Filing INT-4823-rollback and opening a PR for runbook updates. Thanks all :thumbsup:
